name: HAE-RAE Bench
description: HAE-RAE Bench is a Korean language benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' knowledge of Korean culture, vocabulary, history, general knowledge, and reading comprehension. It challenges models on Korean-specific knowledge and cultural context, going beyond typical multilingual benchmarks that rely on translations.
reputation: A niche but well-regarded Korean-language benchmark that is frequently cited for evaluating culturally grounded Korean knowledge beyond translation-based tests.
notes: Focuses on Korean cultural and contextual depth, covering six downstream tasks across four domains.
